title: Communication caps: SMS, WhatsApp, login codes and call minutes metered per plan, alerts at 80% and 100%, upgrade or top-up, OTP abuse limits
goal: Keep SMS, WhatsApp, login codes and calls included in every plan up to a monthly cap, warn the agency before it runs out, and let it upgrade or get extra credits instead of running up an open bill.
why: COST-MODEL.md: every plan loses money as coded because platform-paid SMS (about ₹8 per Indian SMS via Twilio), WhatsApp via Twilio (about ₹0.48 reseller fee per message) and Twilio Verify login codes (about ₹12.90 each) have no cap. checkUsageCap is applied only to /ai/* (index.ts ~227); the sms/whatsapp/email cap keys exist but are never checked; OTP send is limited only per IP+phone. Owner decision 2026-10-14: keep these channels included with a per-plan monthly cap, graceful stop at the cap with upgrade or top-up (super admin grants first, self-serve with billing), 80%/100% alerts, OTP abuse limits; login codes stay on SMS.
steps: services/metering/meter.ts: meterUsage(env, tenantId, channel: sms|whatsapp|otp|call_minute|email, units = 1): allowance = getAllowance (plan + add-ons for the current period, R109); one conditional UPDATE on tenant_usage_caps (current_usage + units <= allowance, period key from R105) so parallel sends never exceed the cap; returns { allowed, used, allowance }; on refusal throws AllowanceExhausted { channel, used, allowance }. WhatsApp: only messages that cost money count (templates and business-initiated messages); replies inside the free 24 h window do not.

Call it before every paid send: routes/communications.ts send (Communication Hub) -> 402 { code: 'ALLOWANCE_EXHAUSTED', channel, used, allowance, options: ['upgrade', 'top_up'] } and the provider is not called; sms-queue.ts, campaign-queue.ts and whatsapp-campaign-queue.ts per recipient (at the cap: remaining recipients marked skipped_allowance, campaign finishes with a clear status and an alert); OTP sends in routes/auth.ts and routes/driver.ts (login codes stay on the existing SMS/Twilio Verify path; at the cap the response tells the user to log in with the password and the admin is alerted; driver OTP at the cap returns a clear message).

Calls (provisional until R305 meters from provider records): POST /calls/outbound refuses with 402 when call_minute usage >= allowance; the status callback adds ceil(duration/60) minutes for completed calls (R305 replaces this with provider records). Never cut a live call.

services/metering/usage-alerts.ts: one alert mechanism for AI credits and every communication channel (no alert mechanism exists for AI credits today; verified 2026-10-14): after each metered use, when used crosses 80% or 100% of the allowance, insert a notification for the tenant admins and send an email via sendTransactional (template usage_alert), once per channel per threshold per period (dedupe key in KV or a small table). Hook it into ai-credits.ts chargeCredits too.

OTP abuse limits (master 0016 otp_requests: id, tenant_id, destination_hash, ip, purpose, created_at): per destination 3 per 10 minutes and 10 per day; per IP 20 per hour; per tenant the plan OTP cap; reject non-mobile and premium-rate numbers; never reveal whether a phone exists. Driver refresh token lifetime 30 days (fewer OTP logins).

Usage for the agency admin: GET /settings/usage returns, per channel and AI credits, used, allowance (plan + add-ons), percent, period end, and the add-on prices from pricing.ts; POST /settings/usage/request-upgrade { kind: plan|top_up, channel? } records a platform enquiry (R116 table if merged, else a notification to the super admin) so the super admin can grant (R109 grant endpoint) until self-serve purchase lands (R206).

Desktop: rename Settings > AI usage to "Usage and limits" (same route, nav label in nav-config.ts) showing all channels with progress bars, 80%/100% states and "Request upgrade" / "Request top-up" buttons; allowance-exhausted-dialog.tsx shown by the API client when any call returns ALLOWANCE_EXHAUSTED or SEAT_LIMIT (wire it where the send dialog and invite form handle errors).
tests: backend/test/metering-caps.test.ts: whatsapp cap 2 -> third template send 402 ALLOWANCE_EXHAUSTED and the provider fetch mock not called; a free-window reply is not metered; SMS campaign of 5 with cap 3 sends 3 and marks 2 skipped; 5 parallel sends with cap 3 never exceed 3; a super admin comm pack grant raises the cap for this period only; crossing 80% creates one notification and one outbox email, crossing 100% another, repeats create none; AI credits use the same alerts; outbound call refused at the minute cap.

backend/test/otp-limits.test.ts: 4th request in 10 minutes for one phone -> 429; 21st from one IP in an hour -> 429; tenant at its OTP cap -> 402 with the password-login message; codes never appear in logs.
Desktop unit test for the usage page and the exhausted dialog (mocked API).
acceptance: Every paid outbound path goes through meterUsage (grep provider send calls and list them in the report).
Alerts fire once per threshold per period (tests).
Agency admins can see usage and request upgrades or top-ups.
gate: cd backend && npx vitest run   # pass: 0 failed files and passed >= the last merged count (1296 on 2026-10-14)
cd desktop && npx tsc --noEmit && npx tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json --noEmit
cd desktop && npx vitest run   # pass: 0 failing files, passed >= last merged count (1294 on 2026-10-14)

cd desktop && E2E_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3110 E2E_API_URL=http://localhost:8797/api/v1 npx playwright test e2e/communication-inbox.spec.ts e2e/campaigns.spec.ts e2e/whatsapp-campaigns.spec.ts e2e/driver-app-api.spec.ts e2e/ai-settings.spec.ts
goLiveVerify: Cap sizes and unit costs confirmed by the owner (Q2b); real provider unit costs per market entered in comm_unit_costs; deliverability of alert emails.
notes: Before editing read: this batch file, docs/readiness/READINESS-PLAN.md sections 0 and the design note for this area, desktop/audit/fix/FIX-PLAN.md sections 3-4 (executor rules, worktree bootstrap with node_modules junctions; never npm install inside a worktree unless the batch adds a dependency, and then only in the main checkout by the orchestrator).

Backend tests follow the existing pattern (see backend/test/voip-callbacks.test.ts): import env, createExecutionContext, waitOnExecutionContext, applyD1Migrations from cloudflare:test; applyD1Migrations(env.MASTER_DB, env.TEST_MIGRATIONS) in beforeAll; POST /api/v1/test/reset; call worker.fetch(request, env, ctx). isolatedStorage is false and singleWorker true, so use unique ids/emails per test file.

Bulk seeding in tests or e2e (many leads, messages or payments) triggers automation recipes; set settings.automations_paused = true for that tenant first (PUT /api/v1/automations/pause or the setting row), then restore it.
The seeded e2e tenant gets generous add-on grants in seed-local (R109); if a spec still hits a cap, raise the grant there rather than weakening the meter.
R117 runs in parallel and owns index.ts in that step; do not edit it.

Desktop UI follows desktop/audit/remake/CONTRACT.md: ds-* indigo tokens only (no raw palette classes or hex), archetypes (ListPage/EntityForm/DetailPage or PageContainer + PageHeader), FilterBar + useInfiniteScroll for lists, RelationCombobox for relations, PhoneInput for phones, useConfirm instead of window.confirm, graceful degradation when an env key is missing. lint-gate must not rise for any file you touch.
